title: What is Three.js?
description: Three.js is a powerful JavaScript library that brings 3D graphics to the web. Built on WebGL, it abstracts away the complexity and gives developers a clean, intuitive API for creating stunning 3D scenes, animations, and interactive experiences.

title: Understanding 3D
description: Three-dimensional graphics create depth and immersion. Every 3D object is constructed from three fundamental building blocks: vertices (points), edges (lines), and faces (surfaces).

title: Your First Scene
description: Setting up a basic React Three Fiber scene is simple. The Canvas component handles all the WebGL setup, and you can add meshes and lights just like regular React components.

title: React Three Fiber Basics
description: R3F makes Three.js feel like React. Props map directly to Three.js properties, constructor arguments use the `args` prop, and vectors/colors have convenient shortcuts.

title: Materials & Textures
description: Materials define how surfaces look, while textures add detail and realism. React Three Fiber supports all Three.js materials and makes loading textures easy with helpers from @react-three/drei.

title: Geometry and Shapes
description: Geometries define the shape of 3D objects. Use the `args` prop to pass constructor arguments. React Three Fiber supports all Three.js geometries.

title: Vertices: The Foundation
description: Vertices are the fundamental points that define 3D geometry. Each vertex has X, Y, and Z coordinates in 3D space. When rendered as points, you see the underlying structure of your geometry.

title: Edges: Connecting the Dots
description: Edges connect vertices together, creating the wireframe skeleton of your 3D object. This wireframe view helps visualize the structure and topology of complex geometries before adding surfaces.

title: Faces: Adding Surfaces
description: Faces are the surfaces created when three or more vertices connect. With faces, we can apply materials, colors, and textures to transform wireframes into solid, visible 3D objects.

title: Interactive Showcase
description: Combine vertices, edges, and faces to create interactive 3D experiences. Try swapping textures below to see how different materials transform the same 3D model in real-time.
